f.pu: To protect the breeding environment of the shy albatross. The global breeding range of the shy albatross(Thalassarche cauta) is restricted to only three Tasmanian islands. Albatross Island is reserved as the second largest shy albatross breeding colony, and the only one in Bass Strait.
f.re: Currently no public access is allowed to the Albatross Island Nature Reserve.
f.rn: Nature Conservation Act 2002; National Parks and Reserves Management Act 2002; National Parks and Reserves Management Regulations 2019

f.n: Flinders Australian Marine Park - Marine National Park Zone - South-east
f.pu: To protect the ecosystem and allow for passive recreation.
f.re: 1. Commercial and recreational fishing are prohibited. Fishing gear must be kept stowed and secured at all times during transit. 2. Mining is prohibited. 3. Anchoring is prohibited except in anchoring areas.
f.rn: South-east Commonwealth Marine Reserves Network – Management Plan 2013-23

f.pu: To protect this biologically diverse area, one of the best temperate diving locations in Australia and home to Tasmania's largest colony of crested terns.
f.re: 1. No fishing or setting of fishing gear is allowed. 2. Do not swim, snorkel or dive in Waubs Gulch due to frequent boating traffic and strong currents. 3. Access to Governor Island is prohibited during the crested tern breeding season between August 1 and March 31.
